Title: Bleeding the Vine interacts with House of Sorrow

Messages.Author: shornbuck1
Messages.Body:
Assume I have Bleeding the Vine out and House of Sorrow out at the same time. Both are untapped.

Another player plays a master phase card, and I tap Bleeding the Vine to cancel it. He then plays another master phase. Can I tap House of Sorrow to untap Bleeding the Vine, then tap Bleeding the Vine to cancel the second master card?

Messages.Author: KevinM
Messages.Body:
No.
